turns.user: What was the Chicxulub impactor and what did it do?

The impact released energy equivalent to roughly 10 billion atomic bombs, causing massive wildfires, a 'nuclear winter'-like effect from ejecta and soot blocking sunlight, global temperature drops, and widespread disruption of photosynthesis. This event is widely accepted as the primary cause of the Cretaceous–Palaeogene (K-Pg) mass extinction, which wiped out approximately 75% of all species on Earth, including all non-avian dinosaurs.
